facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 学生 founder 值得关注
facts_raw.Focus: Student founders / AI-native and general technology
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Earlier-stage students may receive a starter grant; founders ready to raise can be considered for equity funding
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: Starter grant for earlier-stage students; separate equity investment decision for fundraising-ready founders
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: Starter grant is non-dilutive; equity financing follows separate GC investment terms
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 面向 student founders。官方说明无论处于 company-building 哪个阶段都可联系/申请。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 学校/实验室资源优势；已有 side project 或早期产品；AI-native / responsible innovation 方向尤其吻合。
facts_raw.Format: VC student founder fellowship / funding program
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 以 campus community、events 和投资关系为主；无公开全程 residency 要求。
facts_raw.International Founder: Yes — GC states fellows are spread across the country and world
facts_raw.Deadline / Next Intake: Rolling / current availability should be rechecked before applying
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: GC article links directly to funding application and fellows.
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 仍在校的 student founder；从 idea 还未定型到准备第一轮 equity financing 都可以；希望接触 GC 投资人和学生 founder network。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 非学生 founder；成熟公司；只需要 structured residency/on-site program。
facts_raw.Notes: Capital is two-path: very early student = non-dilutive starter grant; fundraising-ready = potential GC equity investment. Amount is not publicly standardized.

facts.Focus: Student founders / AI-native and general technology
facts.Funding / Support: Earlier-stage students may receive a starter grant; founders ready to raise can be considered for equity funding
facts.Funding Trigger: Starter grant for earlier-stage students; separate equity investment decision for fundraising-ready founders
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: Starter grant is non-dilutive; equity financing follows separate GC investment terms
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Student founders at any company-building stage may contact or apply.
facts.Strong-to-Have: University or laboratory resources, a side project or early product; especially relevant to AI-native and responsible innovation.
facts.Format: VC student founder fellowship / funding program
facts.On-site / Attendance: Campus community, events and investment relationships; no full-time residency requirement published.
facts.International Founder: Yes — GC states fellows are spread across the country and world
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard relocation or visa requirement.
facts.Deadline / Next Intake: Rolling / current availability should be rechecked before applying
facts.Public Contact Route: GC article links directly to funding application and fellows.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Current student founders, from early ideas through preparation for a first equity round, seeking GC investors and a student founder network.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Non-student founders, mature companies or those seeking a structured in-person residency.
facts.Notes: Capital is two-path: very early student = non-dilutive starter grant; fundraising-ready = potential GC equity investment. Amount is not publicly standardized.
